subject: Proposed "Bridge Hours" for Global Technical Deep Dive
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-payments.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acme-payments.com>, Rahul Iyer <rahul.iyer@acme-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Request: technical deep dive — inference throughput & caching

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for yesterday's intro call. Our architects (Tom, Rahul) would like a focused technical deep dive on inference throughput, KV/prefix caching behavior, and guidance on multi-region routing. We need the solutions engineer present.

Constraints:
- Our EU team is available between 09:00–12:00 CET.
- US architects (East/West) prefer mornings local time (08:00–11:00 ET / 05:00–08:00 PT).
- APAC (SG/HK/IN) can do evenings (19:00–22:00 SGT).

We realize this is a tough window to find one slot that works for everyone. Would Redwood be open to either a single extended 90–120 minute session at a time that hits a partial overlap, or two ~60-minute sessions to cover region-specific deep dives? We also have a couple of compliance folks who may drop in briefly.

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Senior Infrastructure PM
Acme Payments

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-payments.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: technical deep dive — inference throughput & caching

Priya — thanks for the clear constraints. Happy to align. A few quick notes before we lock anything:

1) Daylight savings: both US and EU just shifted back to standard time, which helps — but it means some calendar conversions folks run by habit ("same time as last month") will be off. We'll include a timezone matrix to avoid confusion.

2) Redwood recommends two 60-minute blocks rather than a single 2-hour session for these reasons:
   - Shorter sessions focus on region-specific topology and reduce cognitive overload for engineers.
   - We can record the global overview and use the second block for a hands-on session with KV-cache logs and perf traces.

3) Proposed "bridge hours" windows (UTC):
   - Option A (EU/US morning overlap): 13:00—14:00 UTC (works for ~14:00 CET, 08:00 ET, 05:00 PT, and 21:00 SGT — tight but possible)
   - Option B (APAC/US late overlap): 03:00—04:00 UTC (early for US West, late evening for APAC — painful for EU)
   - Option C (two-block plan): Block 1 (13:00—14:00 UTC) overview; Block 2 (18:00—19:00 UTC) hands-on for APAC-EU deep dives (will be early for US East but not impossible for one attendee)

I've attached a quick timezone_matrix.csv with converted times for the core participants; Sergio will chime on technical agenda items he wants to include.

If you prefer, we can also split the technical agenda: 40 minutes global overview + 20 minutes region breakout in parallel with our SE(s) on separate calls. That reduces one cross-region long meeting.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: timezone_matrix.csv

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-payments.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acme-payments.com>, Rahul Iyer <rahul.iyer@acme-payments.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:27:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: technical deep dive — inference throughput & caching

Hi Ava — appreciate the options and the matrix. Quick responses from our side:

- Our preference is Option C (two-block plan). Tom and Rahul want the global overview recorded; APAC would like at least one hands-on session they can attend live.
- If needed, we'll have an APAC architect join the 13:00—14:00 UTC slot and hop to the 18:00—19:00 UTC block for the hands-on; they can do 21:00 SGT comfortably.
- We do prefer shorter, focused sessions rather than a single 2 hour meeting.

Could Sergio propose a brief agenda for each block (topics + artifacts to prepare)? Also please confirm if Redwood will share the KV-cache sample traces and an example batch config so our infra team can reproduce locally before the session.

Regards,
Priya

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme-payments.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 15:04:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: technical deep dive — inference throughput & caching

Thanks — I'll lead the SE portion. Proposed agendas:

Block 1 (60m) — Global overview (13:00—14:00 UTC)
- 00–10m: Introductions, topology overview (regions, routing policy)
- 10–25m: Throughput profiles and common bottlenecks (CPU/GPU/KV cache)
- 25–40m: Live walkthrough of prefix/KV caching behavior (recorded demo + Q&A)
- 40–60m: Q&A + align follow-ups and artifacts (we'll share batch configs)

Block 2 (60m) — Hands-on region deep dives (18:00—19:00 UTC)
- 00–15m: Short recap + confirm testbeds
- 15–45m: Live kernel-level perf traces + guided reproducer (we'll ask a host from your infra to run a small script)
- 45–60m: Next steps, handoff to your SREs for a PoC run

I'll attach a sample KV-cache screenshot (kv-cache-sample.png) and the meeting-invite.ics that we'll publish once times are locked. We will also post the batch_config example to a shared Drive link ahead of the first block.

Note on recordings: we'll record Block 1 and provide the recording + artifacts. For Block 2 we recommend live attendance but we can record on request.

Looking forward to it — Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: kv-cache-sample.png
Attachment: meeting-invite.ics
